walkthroughs.body_html:
Information Handling & Modelling — a core area of A-Level Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Information Handling & Modelling brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Information Handling & Modelling.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between CAD and CAM?
options: Shear.
CAD creates digital designs; CAM uses those designs to control manufacturing machines.
They are the same thing with different names.
CAD is for cars, CAM is for cameras.

mcqs.q: What is the purpose of a jig in manufacturing?
options: Shear.
To inspect finished products.
To guide a tool and ensure consistent, accurate repeated operations.
To hold the workpiece very tightly so it does not move.
